workflow_rules.text: Phone root/shell network tests can differ from app behavior. Tailscale on Android may be per-UID; a service started as `shell` or root can miss the VPN routes even when the Tailscale app itself is online.

Do not assume `duckdns:18080` failure means local ttyd is down. Check local, LAN, router NAT, then public URL. Do not use router Web form as the first write path when it times out. Do not assume `duckdns:18080` failure means local ttyd is down. Check local, LAN, router NAT, then public URL.

Do not treat Fedora Silverblue/composefs `/` showing `100%` full as a real writable disk-full condition. The immutable root image can be `59M/59M` by design. Check `/var`, `/var/home`, or the actual writable Btrfs filesystem before alerting or cleaning.
